snippet.title: Tour de France 2026 | Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover what’s new in Tour de France 2026. Pre-order now to get exclusive jerseys.

Adapt to dynamic weather conditions that impact your strategy, especially in the rain where control and precision are key. Take on new licensed races like the Muscat Classic and Paris-Tours, available across multiple game modes.

Team Time Trial mechanics have been updated, letting you manage rider order and race tactics more closely. Riders’ outfits now change based on weather, with added realism including official National Champion jerseys.

Tour de France 2026 launches June 4, 2026. 

Preorder now:
Base game PS5: https://nacon.me/4uyGnka
Deluxe Edition PS5: https://nacon.me/4cXTQw4
Base game Xbox: https://nacon.me/49flCBW
Deluxe Edition Xbox: https://nacon.me/3QLAQbH

Follow us: https://linktr.ee/cyclinggames
